Document: "Standardisation of natural dye powders via spray drying: initial physicochemical characterisation"

The Indigofera powder did not have the highest moisture content of the three dyes. According to Table 1, the moisture content of the Indigofera powder was 9.87% ± 0.08%, which was lower than the moisture content of the Tingi powder (11.27% ± 0.07%).
